CORE ARCHITECTURE

Engineered for Enterprise Intelligence

Six foundational pillars that make Flow the most secure, capable, and autonomous workflow engine for mission-critical operations.

Context Awareness

Flow learns your operational context across every application — the relationships between CRM data, email threads, documents, and spreadsheets — building a real-time knowledge graph of your work.

Smart Data Masking

Sensitive information is identified and protected automatically. PII, financial data, and confidential records are masked before any processing — meeting SOC 2, HIPAA, and GDPR requirements.

Cross-App Integration

Connects your existing tools — Salesforce, HubSpot, Slack, Gmail, Excel, and 200+ enterprise apps. No API keys, no configuration, no IT overhead. Flow operates within your existing stack.

Workflow Engine

A deterministic execution runtime that guarantees reliable outcomes. Every workflow is auditable, versioned, and rollback-capable, with human-in-the-loop checkpoints on critical decisions.

Local-First Security

All processing happens on-device. Your data never leaves your infrastructure — not for training, not for inference, not for storage. Zero third-party risk. Zero external API dependencies.

Autonomous Execution

Once Flow learns a workflow pattern, it executes autonomously — 24/7, without intervention. Trigger actions, update records, send communications, and generate reports automatically.
